overview: Improve the UX with a left sidebar feed selector showing categorized feeds and metrics, modeled after Feedly-style navigation.
goals: Provide a sidebar feed selector with categories
Show basic metrics per feed and category
successMetrics: Users can select any imported feed from the sidebar
Categories reflect OPML outline folders and can be expanded/collapsed
openQuestions: Metric source for unread counts (default: items loaded in this session)
Should category ordering follow OPML order or alphabetical? (default: OPML order)
uiNotes: Add a left sidebar with categories, feed entries, and counts
The main reader remains on the right
Sidebar should be usable on mobile (collapsible)
rules: Categories derive from OPML outline folders
Feeds not in folders go into an "Uncategorized" category
Counts reflect the last loaded items for that feed (session-based)

stories.title: Add sidebar layout and styling
stories.description: As a reader, I want a left sidebar so I can browse feeds by category.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a left sidebar layout with category groups and feed list placeholders
Sidebar is collapsible on small screens

stories.title: Populate sidebar from imported feeds
stories.description: As a user, I want imported OPML feeds to appear in the sidebar under their folders.
acceptanceCriteria: Parse OPML folder names into categories
Render feeds in the sidebar grouped by category
Feeds without a folder appear under "Uncategorized"
Selecting a feed loads it in the reader

stories.title: Add metrics to sidebar
stories.description: As a user, I want to see counts so I know which feeds are most active.
acceptanceCriteria: Show a count per feed based on last loaded items
Show a category count as the sum of its feeds
Counts update when a feed is loaded
